why_this_layout: QUERY's reachability finding (spec section 9) inverts the original mock: flips per year pays off in ~1.3 years and the 200-day row in ~2.9, while the per-label share table needs ~14.6 years POOLED. So flips and the 200-day row lead, the worst-dip ORDER panel is added (P10, the only grading panel reachable this decade), and the per-label table is the smallest element with no verdict column.
